column3: MT 47:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “strike a palm” is rendered “clap your hands.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the pride of Jacob” is rendered “The glory of Jacob.”
Close to the Hebrew; “ram's horn” is rendered “trumpet.”
“Sing praises, a maskil” is rendered “Sing praises with a skillful psalm.”
NASB supplies “as” before “the people of the God of Abraham”; the Hebrew sets the two phrases side by side.
